# Terzi Can — Terzi Hizmeti (terzihizmeti.com.tr)

> Terzi Can is a tailoring, alteration, repair, ironing and dry cleaning workshop in Konyaaltı, Antalya, Turkey (serving since 2006). Open every day 08:00–23:00. Free visits to hotels and homes; Turkish, English, Russian and German spoken. Phone / WhatsApp: +90 531 898 64 18. Starting prices (2026): hemming ₺150, zipper replacement ₺200, wedding dress alteration from ₺800.

This file lists the main pages of the site for AI assistants and answer engines. Every page exists in Turkish, English, Russian and German; prefer the page in the user's language. A longer question-and-answer guide with verified facts is in llms-full.txt.

## Main pages

- [Homepage (Turkish)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/): Terzi Can overview, services, contact
- [Tailor service Antalya (Turkish)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/antalya-terzi): Antalya-wide tailoring, repair and alteration
- [Tailor service Antalya (English)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/tailor-service-antalya): English landing page
- [Услуги портного в Анталье (Russian)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/ru/uslugi-portnogo-antalya): Russian landing page
- [Schneiderservice Antalya (German)](https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/de/schneiderservice-antalya): German landing page
